text: In accordance with City-wide residential demolition control under Article II, Demolition Control, of Municipal Code Ch. 363, as amended by By-law No. 1009-2006, enacted by the City Council on September 27, 2006 under the authority of Section 33 of the Planning Act, I refer the demolition application for 2115 Bloor St. West to you, to decide whether to grant or refuse the application, including any conditions, if any, to be attached to the permit. This staff report is regarding a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. On May 31st, 2018, Toronto Building received a demolition permit application (18-169288 DEM 00 DM) to demolish a two storey vacant residential building located at 2115 Bloor St. West. A building permit application for a replacement building has not been received. The building is located within Ward 13…

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Refused the application (18-169288 DEM 00 DM) to demolish the existing two-storey vacant residential building at 2115 Bloor Street West because a building permit has not been issued for a replacement building on this site.
